value.rationale: The result gives the exact value of a newly introduced partition invariant on the canonical complete-bipartite family. The deficit transition is mathematically structured rather than a routine parameter substitution: one-hub partitions are optimal through shore size \(5\), while from shore size \(6\) two complementary mixed hubs attain a universal four-unit deficit, and the lower bound explains why no smaller excess is possible.
